column1: # GitHub Actions job timeouts (ADR-053 P5) - DATA, not folklore. `scripts/ci actions plan` puts `timeout_min` on every
# matrix job and the workflows use `timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.timeout_min }}` (it was a flat 350 / 120).
#   job              the plan's job name, or a glob (`sabotage_corpus_*` covers the 24 nightly slices)
#   observed_max_min the longest SUCCESSFUL run of that job in `gh run list` / `gh run view --json jobs`
#                    (pr.yml + nightly.yml, 2026-10-10 .. 2026-10-13: 16 PR runs, 5 nightly runs), job start -> end
#   timeout_min      = max(15, 5 * ceil(2 * observed_max_min / 5)): twice the slowest run seen, a 15 min floor.
#                    `scripts/ci actions plan` REFUSES a row that is not this formula: change the observation,
#   runs             how many successful runs the maximum is over (a thin sample is visible here)
# A job with no row gets 60 minutes (`default`) - add its row once it has run. To refresh the table:
#   gh run list --workflow pr.yml --limit 25 --json databaseId,conclusion ; gh run view <id> --json jobs
# and take the max over successful runs per job. pre-P5 flat limits: pr 350, nightly 120.
